notes.title: Recent changes
notes.notes:
Dear community,
[url=http://www.displacementstudios.com]Displacement Studios[/url] acquired [i]SMACKHEAD[/i] and the following changes have been performed:
[list]
[*] two difficulties instead of one
[*] new trailer
[*] Linux/SteamOS support
[*] two new achievements
[*] a more detailed description and rewritten hardware recommendations
[*] controls now shown in the menu
[*] fullscreen/window mode switching at any time
[*] replacement of a low effort intro animation
[/list]
So far, as no bugs have been found, the game is out of development for now. Feel free to leave any feedback as comments!
